main.description: Gets an indexed Certified profile by DID or handle. Handles resolve through the configured resolver's com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle endpoint; no DID document is fetched for independent verification. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID or handle of the profile actor.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor is not a valid DID or handle, or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

errors.name: HandleResolutionFailed
errors.description: The handle could not be resolved to a valid DID.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The actor was identified, but no indexed Certified profile exists.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profile could not be queried.

profile.description: Indexed Certified profile record with its AT-URI, CID, repository DID, and indexing time.
